name: [ UPD66 // 🐉 ]Re:Trials
desc:
///// 🌾 Re:Write your fate 🌾 ///// Gameplay: the game starts in capital city, follows the storyline until arc 3, you need to deal with bosses such as white whale and petelgeuse while traveling with ground dragons.

🌊 Combat: Game offers a combat system with 9 different authorities, 7 different magics, 13 unique weapons for players to choose who to become, and there are currently 26 races and 9 divine protections in the game.

🌿 Grind: Game follows a simple grinding system, you need to defeat bosses and mabeasts across the map to gain experience, players can either prestige or stay at lower levels on their will. Each authority has an unique obtainment, making it feel like players are actually representing them.

Active code: [“675KVISITS”], [“Hero”] - grants 60 total race rerolls.
Note: game owner is not a larper.

Tags: Anime, RPG, Story, Fighting, Magic, Web Novel, Stairs
